title: HMDA mortgage lending data (FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API: applications and originations by loan type, purpose, applicant and place)
agency: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (HMDA data published by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)
questions: how many FHA-insured home purchase loans were originated in each state in 2024
the dollar volume of VA-guaranteed mortgages originated nationwide, 2018-2024
mortgage denial rates by race in a county
FHA share of home purchase originations by state
refinance versus home purchase originations over time
USDA guaranteed mortgage originations in rural states

manual.how: Open https://ffiec.cfpb.gov/data-browser/data/ (Data Browser: pick the year, geography and up to two filters, View Summary Table, Download), or the national loan-level and aggregate files at https://ffiec.cfpb.gov/data-publication/, and upload the files.

cache.why: Each year's data are republished (snapshot, then one- and three-year datasets) and the newest year is added each spring; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: HMDA public data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105), published for public use.

notices: HMDA covers the lenders above the reporting thresholds (most mortgage lending, not all): counts are reported lending, not every mortgage in the country, and purchased loans (action 6) repeat loans another lender originated.
citation: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council, Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data, HMDA Data Browser ({dataset}), ffiec.cfpb.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which loans: originated loans only (actions_taken 1, the default for volumes), or applications with their outcomes (1-5, for denial rates)? Purchased loans (6) repeat loans already reported by the originator and are left out by default.

Which loan purpose: home purchase only (1), refinancing (31, 32), or all purposes? Default: the purpose the question names; otherwise home purchase for housing-market questions and all purposes for total volume, stated in the answer.

Which data vintage? Each year is first published as a snapshot and revised in later one- and three-year datasets; the Data Browser serves the latest it holds. Default: the Data Browser's figures, with the retrieval date.

use_instead.question: House prices and house price indexes
use_instead.why: FHFA's House Price Index; HMDA has loan amounts, not prices.

use_instead.question: Complaints about mortgage servicers or lenders
use_instead.why: The CFPB complaint database; HMDA is lending activity.

use_instead.question: Federal outlays or credit subsidy costs of FHA, VA or USDA loan programs
use_instead.why: Budget figures come from the budget; HMDA gives the lending volume behind them.
